project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 marketplace site
build_system: Next.js 16 with Turbopack. No tailwind.config — Tailwind 4 is loaded via @import 'tailwindcss' inside globals.css. postcss.config.mjs uses @tailwindcss/postcss. Path alias @/* maps to ./* (project root).
test_framework: None. Verification is yarn build only.
verification_instructions: cd /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga && yarn build — must exit 0 with '✓ Generating static pages' and no TypeScript errors.
environment_constraints: Worktree is at /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga. Do NOT write files outside it. Never restart a dev server. yarn build must pass before any commit.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing file conventions: use 'use client' only when hooks/events are needed; use CSS classes from the design system (no inline styles, no Tailwind utility classes); import from @/ aliases.
key_patterns: 1. ALL CSS comes from assets/styles/*.css via globals.css @imports — never write Tailwind utilities or inline styles. 2. Component CSS classes follow oi-* naming. 3. Server components are default; 'use client' only for hooks. 4. Data layer is lib/data.ts (already complete). 5. Types are exported from lib/data.ts as interfaces. 6. lib/cn.ts is a tiny classname helper (no clsx/classnames dep). 7. Route group (site) wraps all public pages with SiteHeader + SiteFooter via app/(site)/layout.tsx. 8. Images are served from /public/assets/ — use /assets/... paths (NOT ../assets/...).
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router. app/(site)/ — route group for all public pages (/, /marketplace, /shops, /shops/[slug], /products/[slug], /login, /signup, /seller, /account, /about). app/layout.tsx — root layout with AuthProvider + ToastProvider. components/auth/ — AuthProvider, AuthForm, AccountView. components/layout/ — SiteHeader, SiteFooter. components/marketplace/ — ProductCard, ShopCard, CategoryGrid, TrustRow, SellerBanner, FilterPanel, AddToCart, RouteSearch, QuerySelect. components/ui/ — Button, ButtonLink, Badge, Icon, SearchField, Toast, Breadcrumbs, Section, StarRating. components/brand/ — Logo. components/views/ — HomeView, SellerDashboard, AboutView. lib/ — cn.ts, data.ts, search-params.ts. assets/styles/ — all CSS. public/assets/ — static files mirrored from assets/.
